en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small bridge over a narrow river or stream, with several children standing on the riverbank and in the shallow water. Behind the bridge are two- and three‑story houses with pitched roofs and trees lining the street. In the upper left, red printed text reads "Radeberg. An der Röder." and red vertical text on the right margin gives the publisher information. The scene appears to be a quiet town view along the Röder river.
